quest.title: The Good Stuff - Quest - Forever
quest.bodyText: The Good Stuff Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs . Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions. Dark Iron Fanny Pack ( 20 ) Description Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky? < Oralius does his best impersonation of a pirate.> ARRR MATEY! IT BE RIGHT! See what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff. Get in there and shake your moneymaker! Progress I can't be bothered right now, <name>. Me and Winky got a meeting to attend. Completion < Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.> OH WONDERFUL! < Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.> DELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies! Take one for yourself, <name>. There's plenty to go around. Rewards You will receive: A Dingy Fanny Pack Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain: Open in Experience Calculator 100 reputation with Ironforge See if you've already completed this by typing: /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(4286))
